description: Code, numerical data, and sources accompanying the manuscript "The Fundamental Memory Ceiling of Noisy Quantum Reservoirs" and its Supplemental Material. The archive contains a density-matrix simulator of driven quantum reservoirs, finite-history estimates of memory depth, stored numerical results, computations for the measurement-free error-correcting reservoir, numerical diagnostics of constants and proof steps, and LaTeX and plotting sources. README.txt describes the contents, dependencies, and reproduction commands. Numerical checks are distinct from a proof of the universal memory bound. This is the local PRL revision 7 source edition dated 18 October 2026; no journal acceptance or public deposition is claimed.
title: Code and data for "The Fundamental Memory Ceiling of Noisy Quantum Reservoirs"
